alt.en: A large wooden crate stands in the center of a gray floor. A dashed teal line with a packet runs left to a standing page with a teal header, and a dashed pink line with a packet runs right to a screen showing a chat. A small cinnabar seal in front is tied to the crate by a dotted gray line.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一个大木箱。一条带数据包的青色虚线向左通往一页顶部为青色的文件，一条粉色虚线向右通往显示对话的屏幕。木箱前方的朱红色小印章以灰色点线与木箱相连。

caption.en: Illustration: a signed package, its seal tied to the crate, still installs an instruction file and steers the replies on a chat screen. It does not depict Haiou, Codex or the gateway, nor a tested deployment, and it does not show that the package checks work as described.
caption.zh: 示意图：带有签名印章的软件包，仍会安装指令文件，并引导对话屏幕上的回答。图中并非 Haiou、Codex 或网关本身，也不代表经过测试的实际部署，更不说明软件包校验如报告所述般运作。
